items.t: Said working families deserve a government that makes their lives more affordable.
items.q: Ohio has spoken, and the message is clear: working families deserve a government that makes their lives more affordable

items.t: Said he and Ohio House Democrats will focus on lowering costs, property tax relief, more affordable housing and childcare, and protecting healthcare access and public schools.
items.q: Leader Isaacsohn and Ohio House Democrats will enter the next General Assembly focused on lowering costs, providing meaningful property tax relief, making housing and childcare more affordable, and protecting access to healthcare and strong public schools.

items.t: Believes in public education as the foundation of strong communities.
items.q: His work reflects an enduring belief in public education as the foundation of strong communities, in housing policy that addresses affordability and stability, and in criminal justice reforms that advance fairness and opportunity.

record.t: Voted in favor of a 90-day gas tax holiday.
record.q: Minority Leader Dani Isaacsohn (D-Cincinnati) today voted in favor of a 90-day gas tax holiday to provide immediate relief to Ohio drivers facing high prices at the pump.

record.t: Announced House passage of the Ohio Transportation Budget (HB 23).
record.q: State Rep. Dani Isaacsohn (D-Cincinnati) today is excited to announce the passage of the bipartisan Ohio Transportation Budget (HB 23) by the House of Representatives.

record.t: Introduced legislation with Rep. Michael Skindell to make the state Earned Income Tax Credit partially refundable.
record.q: State Reps. Michael Skindell (D-Lakewood) and Dani Isaacsohn (D-Cincinnati) today introduced legislation to strengthen the State’s Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC), making it partially refundable.

record.t: Was appointed ranking member of the Finance Subcommittee on Primary and Secondary Education for the 135th General Assembly.
record.q: State Rep. Dani Isaacsohn (D-Cincinnati) has been appointed the ranking member of the Finance Subcommittee on Primary and Secondary Education.

record.t: Co-sponsored a bill to address truancy by paying parents and students for exceptional attendance.
record.q: is co-sponsoring a bill that addresses truancy in his state by paying parents and students for exceptional attendance.
